                                               ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CiTY COUNCIL OF THE CiTY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 2-K in the area bounded by




West Arthington Street;

A line 550.60 feet east of and parallel to South Kilpatrick Avenue;

West Fifth Avenue;

The alley next east of and parallel to South Kilpatrick Avenue;

The alley next south of and parallel to West Arthington Street;

And South Kilpatrick Avenue




to those of a M2-2 Light Industry District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.




Common Address of Property: 4607-4659 West Arthington Street, 4606-10 West Fifth Avenue,
901-11 South Kilpatrick Avenue

10. Lot size in square feet (or dimensions) 72,028 sq. tt. (1.68 acres)
11. Current Use of the property Property is vacant land and the propertv to the north contains
an existing 60,000.0 sq. ft. warehouse to be developed to accommodate low- impact
manufacturing.

12. Reason for rezoning the property To comply with zoning use standards in order to operate_
light industry to accommodate moderate impact manufacturing, whole sales, warehousing, and
distribution uses including storage and work related activities that occur outside ofour enclosed
building.


13. Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number ofdwelling
units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage ofany commercial space; and
height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
Proposed 60,000.0 sq. ft. warehouse building and proposed 60,000.0 sq. ft. warehouse on site
where manufacturing and distribution will occur involving 75-150 emplovees working three
shifts. The proposed and existing building will require outside storage for raw and completed
goods and materials; no residential use, existing 68 on-site parking spaces and approximatelv 36
additional parking spaces proposed for new warehouse. The existing and proposed building's
height is 37 feet.


14. The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive
a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing
Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?
